description: Permanently and irreversibly removes a Sentry release, including all its associated files, identified by its version from the specified organization.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization to which the release belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

version.description: The version identifier of the release to be deleted. This could be a semantic version (e.g., '1.0.0', 'my-app@2.3.1') or a unique commit hash.
version.title: Version

name: delete_organization_release

DeleteOrganizationReleaseResponse.description: Output schema for delete operation. Returns 204 No Content on success with no response body.
DeleteOrganizationReleaseResponse.title: DeleteOrganizationReleaseResponse
